quest.summary: Berries grew thickest where the bells rang, once. I would like to taste them again. Find them.

steps.clue: Maru says his berries grew where the bells rang: the garden behind the ruins, south-east of town. A basket picks them from dawn until dark.

done: Thank you. Take a tool of mine: it is more use to you now than to me.
The stones by the river remember where I buried something.
